name: @opafex/grounding
description: Deterministic checks that an LLM agent's prose is backed by its tool results: fabricated identifiers, citation drift, self-contradiction, unsupported counts and invented written values. Pure, zero dependencies.

scripts.check:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.runGroundingGate!=='function')throw new Error('runGroundingGate missing');console.log('dist loads in plain Node')})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:dist

author: Opafex
